name: Bases View Tabs
changes: Pin view (Pro) and the icon items of the tab menu can now be selected without Pro. They show how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button, and save nothing.
tip: Assign a hotkey to Focus the view tabs in the Hotkeys settings. Then press it and use the arrow keys to pick a view.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases View Tabs is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your Bases.
